description: The keys installing Vinktar needs: the project's public write key (VINKTAR_KEY) with the ingest host, the Sentry-compatible DSN and the Bugsnag-compatible endpoints, and whether a source-map upload key (VINKTAR_CLI_KEY, a secret) exists, with where a person creates one. The secret is never returned: tell the person to add it as a CI secret. Needs a read and write connection. Setup call: never counted.

project.description: Project handle (as in list_projects) or id. Optional when this connection is limited to one project or the workspace has only one.

name: get_project_keys
title: Get project keys
